summary: Amesite Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 5.08 and 8.01 announcing its next Annual Meeting of Stockholders will be held December 10, 2026, a change of more than 30 days from the prior annual meeting held July 13, 2026. The filing sets Rule 14a-8 stockholder proposal and advance-notice nomination deadlines of September 27, 2026, ten days after the report, and notes the Board only recently determined the new meeting date. This is a routine meeting-scheduling and nomination-deadline notice, not a special situation; no transaction terms are stated.
